user.title: Set up HomeAssistantAlarm
user.description: Create a connection on the AlarmServer under 'Profile → Add contact → HomeAssistant'. Server URL, UUID and API key are shown there (the key only once). Then enable the connection for your organizations under 'Subscriptions'.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HomeAssistantAlarm
reconfigure.description: Change server, connection UUID or API key of this entry. The overall entities and their entity IDs are kept. If server or UUID change, alarms already on the new server are only taken over into the sensors, without events.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate HomeAssistantAlarm
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for connection {uuid} was rejected or no longer exists. Please enter a new key.

error.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts, the server is blocking for a moment. Please try again in a minute.

data.test_activates_status: Test alarms set the alarm status

data_description.max_age_minutes: Older alarms (e.g. caught up after a downtime) only update the sensors, without event and alarm status. 0 disables the check.
data_description.test_activates_status: Test alarms always fire the event (with test: true). This decides whether they also switch the alarm status sensors to 'Alarm'.
